applicableAreas: All building elevations; Building 1 through Building 8
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed overhead conductor locations and elevations are not provided. No architectural elevation views show the vertical relationship between overhead conductors and building features (roofs, parapets, overhangs) required to verify compliance with 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Site plan; building perimeters near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits with dimension lines from the outside electric conductor to building edges and projections are not provided. While overhead electric lines (OHE) are depicted on the site plan, no clearance dimensions are annotated from the conductors to buildings, parking, driveways, or other facilities.

applicableAreas: Retaining wall locations along east and south property boundaries near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Retaining wall section details (Sheet 38-39) show wall structural design but do not include overhead conductor elevation data or clearance dimension annotations from the outside conductor to the outermost edge of the wall. Vertical clearance verification from overhead lines to 14-foot maximum height retaining walls cannot be confirmed.

applicableAreas: Entire site; driveways crossing overhead lines; buildings near overhead lines
findings.comment: Survey by registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances (sag measurements at maximum temperature/load conditions) is not provided. While benchmark elevations exist, surveyed overhead conductor elevations and field measurements of actual clearances are missing, preventing verification that clearances meet minimum thresholds.

applicableAreas: South and southeast portions of site near overhead electric lines on landscape plan; southeast corner of property where existing trees overlap overhead line routing
findings.comment: Existing trees near overhead electric lines and proposed mitigation trees (marked 'M') adjacent to overhead lines lack required clearance verification and species identification. No lateral distance dimensions shown from tree locations to conductors; species not identified on landscape sheets to verify utility compatibility (UC designation per ECM Appendix F). Required 10 lateral feet minimum for distribution lines or 50 lateral feet for transmission lines cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8; multiple buildings near overhead electric lines along south, east, and west boundaries
findings.comment: Building locations shown on site plan near overhead electric lines (OHE), but horizontal sky-to-ground clearance dimensions from outside conductor to building faces not dimensioned. Compliance with 7.5-foot minimum horizontal sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified from plan view alone without building elevation sheets.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8; parking areas; utility boxes near overhead lines
findings.comment: Customer facilities (buildings, parking, electrical equipment) shown near overhead distribution lines, but 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor not dimensioned. Required clearance distance in all directions from primary and neutral conductors cannot be verified from available plan documentation.

applicableAreas: Wood fence along east property boundary; pond perimeter fence near overhead lines on north boundary; wood fencing at southeast corner
findings.comment: Multiple fence segments shown in close proximity to overhead electric lines but no clearance dimensions provided showing 7.5-foot minimum horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor. Exact fence locations and clearances from overhead conductors cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: East property boundary fence near utility poles; southeast corner fence/pole area
findings.comment: Utility poles visible along property boundaries near fenced areas, but dimension callouts showing 10-foot minimum clearance between fence posts and electric utility poles are not provided. Specific fence post locations relative to pole locations cannot be verified from plan documentation.

applicableAreas: Fences along east and south boundaries where transmission facilities exist
findings.comment: Fencing is shown in areas with transmission electric lines (per transmission easement noted on Sheet 3), but material specifications (non-conductive requirement) and grounding details are not provided on construction detail sheets or notes. Compliance with transmission line fencing requirements cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls along east property boundary beneath overhead electric lines; retaining wall along south boundary near overhead lines
findings.comment: Retaining walls shown on site plan and in section detail views, but clearance dimensions from the outside conductor to the outermost edge of retaining wall faces are not provided. Horizontal sky-to-ground clearance verification from overhead lines to walls cannot be completed.

applicableAreas: Primary west driveway entrance; secondary southwest driveway entrance where Type III driveways cross overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Driveways shown crossing overhead electric lines on site plan, but vertical clearance dimensions are not provided. Required 16-foot minimum vertical clearance (for parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot minimum (for areas with truck traffic) cannot be verified. No section view showing finished driveway grade relative to overhead conductor sag is provided.

applicableAreas: Surface parking spaces located near west driveway entrance adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: Parking areas shown near overhead lines, but vertical clearance dimensions or note addressing required clearance (12 feet for residential pedestrian areas; 16 feet for parking without truck traffic; 18 feet with truck traffic) are not provided. Clearance from lowest overhead facilities to parking surface cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Driveways and site features in areas crossed by transmission lines (based on transmission easement references on Sheet 3)
findings.comment: Transmission lines noted on Sheet 3 and referenced in transmission easement notes, but no grading plan sections or elevation data show vertical clearance from finished grade to lowest transmission conductor. Required 30-foot minimum vertical clearance for roads/driveways beneath transmission lines cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All site features near overhead lines
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are provided on the site plan from any features to overhead electric lines. Therefore, measurement methodology (whether from outside conductor vs. pole centerline) cannot be assessed. Per UCM § 1.10.3 and measurement methodology requirements, dimensions must originate from the outside conductor location, not pole center.

applicableAreas: Sidewalk alignment along Valley View Road right-of-way where utility poles exist at property corners
findings.comment: Sidewalks shown on site plan and detail sheets, and utility poles are depicted at property boundaries along right-of-way, but dimension callouts showing clear spacing between sidewalk construction and existing power poles are not provided.

applicableAreas: Water meter location shown in northwest corner near utility cluster
findings.comment: Water meter location identified on utility plans but clearance dimension from the outside conductor of overhead electric service lines is not annotated. Required 7.5-foot minimum horizontal sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified from available documentation.

applicableAreas: Water utility lines routing across site near overhead electric distribution facilities
findings.comment: Water lines shown on utility plans routing across site where overhead electric facilities exist, but clearance dimensions from water lines to overhead conductors are not provided. Minimum clearance separation cannot be verified from plan documentation.

applicableAreas: Driveways and accessible paths in areas with transmission structures and down guy anchors
findings.comment: Transmission lines and transmission easement noted on Sheet 3; overhead line poles depicted on site plan. Electric Transmission Notes (Sheet 3, Item 2) reference 'down guy anchors' in restriction zone but specific down guy anchor locations and conflicts with proposed driveways are not documented. Whether down guy wires conflict with accessible paths or need relocation/conversion to self-supporting poles cannot be determined from available plans.

applicableAreas: Pad-mounted transformers shown on electrical design plan near proposed buildings
findings.comment: Proposed pad-mounted electrical transformers shown on preliminary electrical design plan, but no section view providing vertical clearance dimension from top of transformer equipment to lowest overhead electric line is provided. Compliance with 7.5-foot minimum sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Construction staging area; equipment operation zones; crane swing radius during construction
findings.comment: No construction logistics plan, staging area diagram, or crane swing plan provided on site plan set. Required 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead lines during construction and material staging cannot be verified. OSHA working clearance compliance cannot be documented.

applicableAreas: Entire site; all construction activities near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Electric Transmission Notes on Sheet 3 include a requirement for 'pre-construction safety meeting...48 hours before commencement of construction' with Austin Energy; however, this requirement appears only in transmission-specific notes, not as a prominent general note visible to all contractors on the cover sheet or general notes section. Clear contractor-facing notation of the 48-hour notification requirement per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 should be on the cover sheet or general notes.
